wholePhysicalScope: The named Abydos archaeological perimeter and mapped standing L-shaped temple outline establish the plan and northeast orientation. Edward Bell’s historic published plan supplies the porch, interior column and chapel spacing.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the standing L-shaped limestone temple, twelve stone piers and low court remains. Near levels add slab and relief details.
limitations: The model shows surviving ancient masonry as represented by the 1990 exterior and current mapped building. Court stumps, surface wear and select threshold elevations are approximate.
Roof slab divisions, simplified porch reliefs and internal walls represent the measured layout and available views. The Osireion and adjacent separate temples fall outside its scope.
